cells.gaps: No source says Simpol, launched in all 22 municipalities on 28 October 2026, records payers or payments yet; it is to back property tax collection from 2027. What is recorded and where it is held are not established.
cells.note: Simpol was presented to municipal staff and set to apply in all 22 municipalities from 28 October 2026, which is a system being rolled out, not yet shown recording revenue, so stage 2. Stage 3 needs a register or receipts live in some municipalities.
